title: First Vanguard week as a leader with Carter, Barron and Nash
summary: He assembled Ron Carter, Kenny Barron and Lewis Nash to win a Village Vanguard week and called Elvin for his first record.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Have you had potential managers or club owners who would say to you, well if you only did more, you know, organ trio type stuff or if you had a little more, put some reggae into your act, or tried to insert musical decisions for you?

I’ve never had a club owner tell me a musical prowess such as that, but I’ve had club owners asking is there a way that we could beef up the lineup. Now, the first gig I ever had in my life, in New York as a leader was at the Village Vanguard. I went up to the owner, Lorraine Gordon, and said, “I’d like to work the Vanguard.” And she said, “Well listen, who’s going to be in your band?” I said, “Well let me make some phone calls.” Well I knew Ron Carter, not as well as I know him now but I knew him to a point that I felt comfortable with asking him if he’d support me. I called Kenny Barron and I called Louis Nash. She didn’t tell me that, but intuitively I felt if I got these names she will give me a week. I went back and I said, “I’ve got Kenny Barron, Ron Carter and Louis Nash.” She gave me a week. That was a lot a pressure, and I learned a lot though. But the point of it is is if you know you’re going to play Carnegie Hall, you’ve got to try to fill Carnegie Hall up, right? So you have to have, and I do have this, I don’t know what you’d say, a high end nature. And so my first record I called Elvin, and he did it. So I have always felt that, not that there’s a level, but I’ve never been too nervous to call anybody. So the fact that I have to call these clubs and try to get a performance opportunity for myself, it’s not that big of a deal. I’ve never had a problem with that.

I think that’s really interesting in that sometimes when you see a new artist and you see the cast of supporting characters in it, like wow, I always thought that that probably came from the record company. Like you need to have this to help sell your first.
